h1c_interaction.interpretation: H1c is confirmed faster than H1a but not distinguishable from H1b after accounting for paired spread. The direction of the H1c−H1a and H1b−H0 contrasts indicates a material context-dependent block-62 effect; adding block 63 on top of block 62 had no confirmed effect in these repeats.

interpretation.largest_useful_transition: No tested hybrid produced a confirmed end-to-end decode gain over fresh H0. H3 had the highest hybrid serial target rate (5.52% vs H0), but its decode rate was -6.31% and draft acceptance was -0.0549 below H0. H1b was the closest hybrid by discovery decode rate, but its three paired confirmations classified it as a regression. Full B0 gained serial speed but also reduced acceptance and speculative decode throughput; no tested point is a useful end-to-end transition over H0.
interpretation.model_quality_conclusion: not measured; no quality equivalence or production recommendation is implied

original_qwen_drafter_effectiveness.interpretation: The original drafter continued to accelerate every tested target over that target's serial path; its acceptance and end-to-end rate declined at some Bonsai-heavy points. This does not imply compatibility parity or quality equivalence.
